# Popup-over-popup NL spec misses the Workstation Participation subclass

## Context

Since 2026-09-08, every #17844 census has recorded all three `WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL` arms red at the same wait, before any window moves. The popup-over-popup native titlebar drop had no working witness in that time.

This is a fourth failure mode. The three 2026-09-02 symptoms that #18121 records are a different set.

Filed after the repair, as the delivered leaf for PR #18681. Its review found that a lookup fix does not deliver #18121's AC-1, which asks for attribution of those three historical symptoms.

## The Problem

The journey's `participations(app)` helper found cross-window participations with `app.findInstances({className: 'Neo.dashboard.dock.window.Participation'})`. Commit 5769bc93d6 (PR #18469, 2026-09-08) composed the Workstation's main target as `Workstation.window.Participation`, a subclass with its own className. The exact-className selector stopped matching the main target:

- `popOut`'s wait, "the detach projection refresh re-registers the main target after <item>", could never pass, so every arm died there.
- With that wait relaxed, a headed run at 4add999757 stopped at "both vessels register as cross-window targets beside the main workspace", receiving two of three.

Nothing in the journey looked at the vessel stand-in either. A pane left behind "Moving pane to another window…", the defect class #18676 names, could not fail it.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/dashboard/dock/window/Participation.mjs`: className `Neo.dashboard.dock.window.Participation`, ntype `dock-crosswindow-participation`.
- `apps/workstation/window/Participation.mjs`: `extends DockParticipation`, declares only its own className and inherits the ntype.
- Measured on `app.findInstances`: the exact className selector misses the subclass, while the ntype selector finds all three participations at the head.
- `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL.spec.mjs`: `participations()` at :151, the `popOut` re-registration wait at :236, the registration check at :304.
- The stand-in is `Neo.dashboard.dock.window.VesselPlaceholder`, with `baseCls: ['neo-dashboard-dock-vessel-placeholder']`.

## The Fix

Spec only. Select participations by ntype. Assert embodiment where the journey asserted only the document:
- pop-out requires the main window to retire its stand-in;
- the transfer requires that neither the main window nor the target vessel keeps one.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 The journey resolves cross-window participations by the ntype a host subclass keeps. All three arms pass the `popOut` re-registration wait and the registration check, headed, at the dev head.
- [ ] AC-2 Pop-out requires the main window to retire its stand-in, and the transfer requires that neither the main window nor the target vessel keeps one.
- [ ] AC-3 The three arms pass 5/5 consecutively, headed, at the dev head under the Brain root, and `WorkstationNativeTitlebarDragNL` stays 1/1.

## Out of Scope

- #18121's three 2026-09-02 symptoms: placement hand-off, a closed target during the placement wait, and a main-window claim tie. They stay on #18121, unattributed.
- Running the spec in a CI workflow.
- A shared, display-aware window-placement rig (#18682).
